verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect control over retention. Users can choose to persist data by mounting S3/R2 buckets or taking point-in-time snapshots to R2, and can 'manage' files in the sandbox filesystem. A community user notes the docs offer no idle auto-destroy, so implementers must do their own cleanup, and another notes that file persistence across idle states is unclear. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox destroy/delete API, configurable retention or TTL policies, auto-deletion on idle, clear documentation of filesystem persistence semantics, and any data-retention or privacy policy documentation.
